scripts.features:
KEY IS ON DISCORD!!!

⚔️ Main
Kill Aura: Automatically attacks all nearby enemies within a customizable range.

God Mode: Makes you invincible by constantly healing you. 🛡️

Destroy All Meteors: Automatically finds and destroys all meteor and obsidiron nodes from the current event. ☄️

📦 Item Spawner / Bringer
Custom Amount: Choose exactly how many of each item you want to bring.

Custom Location: Teleport items directly to your Player, the Campfire, or the Workbench. 📍

Item Selection: Bring items from various categories:

⚙️ Gear (Sheet Metal, Broken Fan, etc.)

🔥 Fuel (Log, Coal, etc.)

🥕 Food/Heal (Carrot, MedKit, etc.)

🛡️ Equipment (Swords, Armor, Sacks, etc.)

🐺 Other Items (Totems, Pelts, Corpses, etc.)

⭐ Event Items (Gold Shards, Meteor Shards, etc.)

🤖 Automation
Auto Wood Farm: Automatically chops down a set number of trees of a specific type (Small or Big). 🌲

Auto Open Chests: Remotely opens all available chests on the map and brings the loot to you. 🪙

Auto Cook Stew: Automatically finds ingredients, adds them to a crock pot, and collects the cooked stew. 🍲

Auto Rescue Child: Finds the closest lost child, teleports to them, and automatically rescues them. 🎒

Auto Tame: Instantly wins the taming minigame, allowing you to tame animals without effort. 🎶

Auto Wall Builder: Automatically plants a defensive wall of saplings around the campfire. You can customize the shape (circle/square), radius, number of saplings, and planting speed. 🧱

👀 Visuals
ESP (Glow / Highlight): Makes certain objects and characters glow so you can see them through walls.

🟡 Chests

🔵 Lost Children

🔴 Cultists

🟠 Wolves

🟤 Bears

Full Bright: Lights up the entire map, removing shadows and making it feel like daytime. ☀️

Remove Fog: Removes all fog for a perfectly clear view of the map. 🌫️❌

🏃‍♂️ Player
Walk Speed: Adjust your character's walking speed.

Noclip: Fly through walls and objects like a ghost. 👻

Fly: A classic flight mode to soar through the sky. 🚀

Fly Speed: Customize how fast you move while flying.

✨ Teleport
Teleport to Locations: Instantly travel to key places like the Campfire or other major Landmarks (Volcano, Stronghold, etc.).

Teleport to Players: Instantly travel to any other player in the server. 🗺️

⚙️ Miscellaneous
Instant Interact: Complete any interaction that requires holding down the 'E' key instantly. 👉

Copy Discord Invite: Copies the developer's Discord server invite link to your clipboard. 💬

Touch Fling: A troll feature that sends players flying when you touch them. 🌪️
